decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out only in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:
265/SR/PL/108 (Site Location Plan, Floor Plans and Elevations), excluding the landscaping details shown thereon; and
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020) and the London Plan (2021).
The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes such as a living room, bedroom, kitchen, as a separate unit of accommodation or for any business purposes.

To avoid any future fragmentation of the curtilage or the creation of a separate residential or business use, so as to protect the amenity of adjoining residential properties in accordance with Policies DMH 4, DMHB 11, DMHB 16, DMHB 18 and DMT 6 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (January 2020).

All hard and soft landscaping works shown on the approved plan (Landscape Plan & Planting Specification (Received 19th August 2026)), including removal of paving slabs to the rear of the outbuilding, shall be carried out and completed no later than nine months from the date of this permission.

The removal of paving slabs and any associated excavation works adjacent to retained trees shall be undertaken by hand and carried out with due regard to the protection of tree roots. Mechanical excavation is not permitted within the root protection area. Any roots encountered should be retained and protected wherever practicable to minimise harm to the health and longevity of the trees.

Any trees, shrubs or plants comprised within the approved landscaping scheme which, within a period of five years from the completion of the landscaping works, are removed, die, become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species, unless ot
For avoidance of doubt, artificial planting is not acceptable and has not been approved.
description: Erection of outbuilding to rear garden including landscaping (Part-Retrospective Planning Application)
